ndsm.alignment_note: The source is a JPEG without CRS/affine sidecar. The model view must reject it until a verified coregistration record is supplied.

label_participant.alignment_evidence: Official ISPRS participant label with the same Potsdam scene identifier; catalog checks matching dimensions before accepting this pixel-local pairing.

label_full.alignment_evidence: Official scene-matched participant label for the same Potsdam tile; catalog validation must additionally verify its grid metadata or record the source pairing.

label_eroded.alignment_evidence: Official scene-matched reference label; use only with the matching Potsdam scene and record this source pairing.

notes: Scene IDs are canonicalized as row_column without zero padding; DSM filenames use two-digit row and column components.
license_id is intentionally null until the applicable redistribution/license terms are verified from the source.
